# netactuate_oidc_client_keys (Data Source)

Reads OIDC Client Keys visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_oidc_client_keys" "example" {
  oidc_client_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `oidc_client_id` (Number) OIDC client ID

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `keys` (List of Object) Keys attached to the OIDC client (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--keys))

<a id="nestedatt--keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `keys`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String)
- `key_id` (Number)
- `label` (String)
- `provided_on` (String)
- `public_key` (String)
- `type` (String)
